title: IdentityModel
description: A helper library for OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect discovery, token requests, and introspection.

data.text: `IdentityModel` is a companion library to `IdentityServer`. It provides lightweight client utilities for OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, including discovery, token requests, introspection, and revocation.
Use `DiscoveryClient` to fetch the OpenID Connect metadata from an authority, removing the need to hardcode token and userinfo endpoints.

data.title: Discovery
data.content: Discover endpoints from an identity provider.

data.text: Use `TokenClient` to request access tokens using client credentials, authorization code, or resource owner password flows.

data.title: Client Credentials Token Request
data.content: Request an access token using client credentials.

terms.definition: Retrieves OpenID Connect configuration from an authority.
Requests tokens from an OAuth 2.0 token endpoint.
Validates reference tokens by calling an introspection endpoint.

data.title: Tip
data.text: IdentityModel works well with both server-side and client-side .NET applications. It removes the boilerplate of building HTTP requests for OAuth flows.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Supports client credentials, authorization code, and ROPC flows
Lightweight alternative to full OAuth client libraries
data.takeaway: IdentityModel provides the minimal utilities needed to integrate with modern identity providers.
